faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Chitrakoot Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DCPU Chitrakoot Support Person recruitment is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university in India to be eligible for the Support Person post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Support Person position is between 21 years and 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Support Person role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Support Person role is Rs. 15000/- per case, which includes travel expenses.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DCPU Chitrakoot Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by sending the duly filled application form along with required documents to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Support Person post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Does the candidate need to be a resident of Chitrakoot district?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be residents of Uttar Pradesh and specifically of Chitrakoot district for approximately 10 years.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity released by the District Child Protection Unit Chitrakoot.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
